title: Install dual-mass flywheel, clutch and release bearing

notices.text: NEW TTY FLYWHEEL BOLTS, no exceptions — the OEM bolts stretch by design and are single-use. Torque 25 Nm then 90 degrees with a proper angle gauge. Centre the clutch disc with an alignment tool before final-torquing the pressure plate, and tighten the cover bolts in a star pattern in stages. Fit the new release bearing and check the guide tube for wear. Photograph the assembly before the transmission goes on.

steps.text: Install dual-mass flywheel, clutch and release bearing.
